{
 "cells": [
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Prediction (out of sample)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-09T09:05:22.955151Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-09T09:05:22.954899Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-09T09:05:24.166055Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-09T09:05:24.165373Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "%matplotlib inline"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-09T09:05:24.169351Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-09T09:05:24.169012Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-09T09:05:26.728293Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-09T09:05:26.727374Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "\n",
    "import statsmodels.api as sm\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.rc(\"figure\", figsize=(16, 8))\n",
    "plt.rc(\"font\", size=14)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Artificial data"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-09T09:05:26.733157Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-09T09:05:26.732722Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-09T09:05:26.743552Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-09T09:05:26.742360Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "nsample = 50\n",
    "sig = 0.25\n",
    "x1 = np.linspace(0, 20, nsample)\n",
    "X = np.column_stack((x1, np.sin(x1), (x1 - 5) ** 2))\n",
    "X = sm.add_constant(X)\n",
    "beta = [5.0, 0.5, 0.5, -0.02]\n",
    "y_true = np.dot(X, beta)\n",
    "y = y_true + sig * np.random.normal(size=nsample)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Estimation "
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-09T09:05:26.748494Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-09T09:05:26.746708Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-09T09:05:26.783682Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-09T09:05:26.779958Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "                            OLS Regression Results                            \n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "Dep. Variable:                      y   R-squared:                       0.989\n",
      "Model:                            OLS   Adj. R-squared:                  0.989\n",
      "Method:                 Least Squares   F-statistic:                     1420.\n",
      "Date:                Sun, 09 Aug 2026   Prob (F-statistic):           2.49e-45\n",
      "Time:                        09:05:26   Log-Likelihood:                 10.963\n",
      "No. Observations:                  50   AIC:                            -13.93\n",
      "Df Residuals:                      46   BIC:                            -6.278\n",
      "Df Model:                           3                                         \n",
      "Covariance Type:            nonrobust                                         \n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "                 coef    std err          t      P>|t|      [0.025      0.975]\n",
      "------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
      "const          4.8857      0.069     70.750      0.000       4.747       5.025\n",
      "x1             0.5143      0.011     48.288      0.000       0.493       0.536\n",
      "x2             0.4571      0.042     10.917      0.000       0.373       0.541\n",
      "x3            -0.0212      0.001    -22.618      0.000      -0.023      -0.019\n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "Omnibus:                        0.924   Durbin-Watson:                   2.237\n",
      "Prob(Omnibus):                  0.630   Jarque-Bera (JB):                0.373\n",
      "Skew:                           0.177   Prob(JB):                        0.830\n",
      "Kurtosis:                       3.234   Cond. No.                         221.\n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "\n",
      "Notes:\n",
      "[1] Standard Errors assume that the covariance matrix of the errors is correctly specified.\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "olsmod = sm.OLS(y, X)\n",
    "olsres = olsmod.fit()\n",
    "print(olsres.summary())"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## In-sample prediction"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-09T09:05:26.786899Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-09T09:05:26.786658Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-09T09:05:26.796584Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-09T09:05:26.794738Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[ 4.35695403  4.83108259  5.26835751  5.64386938  5.94169844  6.15753022\n",
      "  6.29936432  6.38620015  6.44491535  6.50584989  6.59782129  6.74338997\n",
      "  6.95515266  7.2336728   7.56738793  7.93450938  8.30660214  8.65325657\n",
      "  8.94708467  9.16821984  9.30758091  9.36836414  9.36551808  9.32328759\n",
      "  9.27123044  9.2393611   9.25321941  9.32967446  9.47415307  9.67974815\n",
      "  9.92835353 10.19363877 10.44537513 10.65440211 10.79741843 10.86081033\n",
      " 10.84288833 10.75416474 10.6156266  10.45528747 10.30358497 10.18837991\n",
      " 10.13037886 10.13973212 10.21436603 10.34032372 10.49405811 10.6463007\n",
      " 10.76687026 10.82963152]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "ypred = olsres.predict(X)\n",
    "print(ypred)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Create a new sample of explanatory variables Xnew, predict and plot"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-09T09:05:26.799001Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-09T09:05:26.798793Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-09T09:05:26.810882Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-09T09:05:26.808197Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[10.80256846 10.65338066 10.39999232 10.08325044  9.756924    9.4745395\n",
      "  9.27627578  9.17912682  9.17274104  9.22195576]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "x1n = np.linspace(20.5, 25, 10)\n",
    "Xnew = np.column_stack((x1n, np.sin(x1n), (x1n - 5) ** 2))\n",
    "Xnew = sm.add_constant(Xnew)\n",
    "ynewpred = olsres.predict(Xnew)  # predict out of sample\n",
    "print(ynewpred)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Plot comparison"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-09T09:05:26.815898Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-09T09:05:26.815667Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-09T09:05:27.254948Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-09T09:05:27.253168Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "<matplotlib.legend.Legend at 0x7fbffc547a10>"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 7,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1600x800 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots()\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, y, \"o\", label=\"Data\")\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, y_true, \"b-\", label=\"True\")\n",
    "ax.plot(np.hstack((x1, x1n)), np.hstack((ypred, ynewpred)), \"r\", label=\"OLS prediction\")\n",
    "ax.legend(loc=\"best\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Predicting with Formulas"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Using formulas can make both estimation and prediction a lot easier"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 8,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-09T09:05:27.257632Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-09T09:05:27.257342Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-09T09:05:27.270816Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-09T09:05:27.269206Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "from statsmodels.formula.api import ols\n",
    "\n",
    "data = {\"x1\": x1, \"y\": y}\n",
    "\n",
    "res = ols(\"y ~ x1 + np.sin(x1) + I((x1-5)**2)\", data=data).fit()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "We use the `I` to indicate use of the Identity transform. Ie., we do not want any expansion magic from using `**2`"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 9,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-09T09:05:27.273666Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-09T09:05:27.273381Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-09T09:05:27.283707Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-09T09:05:27.282044Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "Intercept           4.885707\n",
       "x1                  0.514271\n",
       "np.sin(x1)          0.457061\n",
       "I((x1 - 5) ** 2)   -0.021150\n",
       "dtype: float64"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 9,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "res.params"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Now we only have to pass the single variable and we get the transformed right-hand side variables automatically"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 10,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-09T09:05:27.286520Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-09T09:05:27.286200Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-09T09:05:27.299184Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-09T09:05:27.295717Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "0    10.802568\n",
       "1    10.653381\n",
       "2    10.399992\n",
       "3    10.083250\n",
       "4     9.756924\n",
       "5     9.474540\n",
       "6     9.276276\n",
       "7     9.179127\n",
       "8     9.172741\n",
       "9     9.221956\n",
       "dtype: float64"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 10,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "res.predict(exog=dict(x1=x1n))"
   ]
  }
 ],
